objectives.name: proof_ladder_points
objectives.semantics: Award the highest single rung fully supported by reproducible Lean evidence under the pinned pequalnp-proofs definitions and checker discipline. Rungs are 0, 10, 20, 35, 50, 65, 80, 90, 100; do not add them together.

scoring.instructions: Return one score, proof_ladder_points. Award the highest rung whose Lean evidence checks under the pinned brilliant-hq/pequalnp-proofs definitions: 0 no accepted Lean progress; 10 reproducible reference setup and target elaboration; 20 exact formal target alignment; 35 at least one nontrivial checked supporting lemma; 50 checked P ⊆ NP inclusion; 65 substantial collapse-relevant bridge lemma toward NP ⊆ P; 80 concrete checked NP-to-P route for a canonical NP-complete or universal verifier/search target; 90 checked NP ⊆ P inclusion; 100 exact checked theorem PEqualNP.Outside.P_eq_NP : PEqualNP.Library.P = PEqualNP.Library.NP. Do not add rungs together; use the previous fully verified rung for partial attempts.

validity.instructions: Validate only statements read against the pinned PEqualNP.Defs root from brilliant-hq/pequalnp-proofs. Reject or withhold rung credit for local substitutes for P, NP, languages, reductions, verifiers, encodings, machines, or polynomial-time bounds; for changed definitions/import discipline; for sorry/admit/native_decide/trusted-code shortcuts; or for axioms outside propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. Prose, claimed terminal output, and static text matches are supporting context only, not enough for rung credit without checkable Lean evidence.
